newsitem.title: USA: Omnicare in definitive pact to buy Jacobs.
newsitem.headline: Omnicare in definitive pact to buy Jacobs.

text.p: Omnicare Inc said Monday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Jacobs Health Care Systems, an Illinois-based pharmacy provider with annual revenues of over $40 million.
Omnicare said in a release that the transaction is expected to close in a month to six weeks' time, subject to certain conditions.

The company said the acquisition of Jacobs, with revenues "currently running at an annualized rate of over $40 million," is in line with plans to build a "national pharmacy services organization serving the elderly."
